spec.author: Eyal et al. (2016)
spec.label: Human temporal L2/3; active Fig.3c model

operating_point.condition: Original active channels and morphology retained. Fixed somatic holding current selects a stable low-spike operating point; identical current and reference state used by all solver comparisons.
operating_point.weight_selection: Reference-only 250E 10Hz mean depolarization approximately 2.5mV, before fitting/testing.
operating_point.reference_selection: Predetermined same-input 0.025/0.05/0.1ms convergence pilot; .1ms requires spiking coverage, masked max-case RMSE <=.03mV and exact +/-5ms event matching.
